source_title: ODOT Size & Weight Permits — OAC 730:50-5 (Size and Weight Permit Load), eff. 2023-09-11
verify_reasons: Oklahoma defines a superload by weight only — any overweight load exceeding the OL-1 reference-truck loading (OAC 730:50-5-4), triggering a bridge structural analysis — with no published width/height/length superload number, so those thresholds are null and the handler flags very large dimensions for manual review.
No dimensional or weight threshold in the ODOT rules automatically triggers a police/OHP escort; police escort is discretionary/route-specific, so it is not encoded.

superload_thresholds.note: Oklahoma defines a superload as any overweight permit load exceeding the Standard Drawing OL-1 reference trucks (OAC 730:50-5-4(l)), requiring a detailed bridge structural analysis of every bridge on the route — there is no fixed width/height/length/gross superload number. Dual-lane superload review caps width at 16' on the Interstate and 20' on state highways with per-axle limits of 20,000 lbs. Permit trigger: over 80,000 lbs on the Interstate, over 90,000 lbs on other state highways.

width.note: 1 front escort on two-lane/super-two, 1 rear escort on multilane (OAC 730:50-5-18(b))
2 escorts (front+rear) on two-lane/super-two; rear escort on multilane
2 escorts (front+rear) on all roads and highways over 16' wide

height.note: 2 escorts (front+rear) plus a non-conductive height/measuring pole at or over 15'9"; permittee must contact all utilities and railroads on route (OAC 730:50-5-16/730:50-5-18)

length.note: 1 front escort over 80' overall on two-lane/super-two highways
2 escorts (front+rear) over 100' overall on two-lane/super-two highways

single_trip.fee_formula: Oversize only = $40. Overweight only = $40 + $10 per each 1,000 lbs over the legal limit. Oversize + overweight combined = $80 + $10 per each 1,000 lbs over the legal limit. Multi-trip = $40/month (max $480 for 12 months). Special movement of newly-manufactured items over 16' to 23' wide = $500. Credit-card convenience fee 4%.
single_trip.note: Single-trip/monthly permit; overweight surcharge is per-1,000-lb over legal (OAC 730:50-5 fee schedule).

annual.note: Annual Envelope permit $4,000 (12'W / 14'H / 110'L); Electric Utility Vehicle $4,000; Special Overload (5% weight variance) $350; Special Combination (triples) $240; Longer Combination (doubles 80k-90k lbs) $20; Round Bale Hay / Tree-Length Logs annual $25.

movement_restrictions: Daylight movement only — 30 minutes before sunrise to 30 minutes after sunset, 7 days a week (ODOT Size & Weight rules)

Metro rush-hour ban on the Interstate System only: no oversize movement in Oklahoma, Tulsa and Cleveland counties 7:00-9:00 AM and 3:30-6:30 PM Mon-Fri (OAC 730:50-5-1(1)); the 2-mile I-35 segment in Cleveland County between Exits 106 and 108 is exempt; ban does not apply to special/longer-combination or overweight-only loads
No movement in snow, ice, fog, high wind or other unsafe weather (OAC 730:50-5-1(4))
Houses/buildings may not be moved on Saturday or Sunday (OAC 730:50-5-21)
notes: Legal width 8'6", height 13'6" (thirteen and one-half feet), semitrailer 53' (permits available 53'-59'6"), gross 80,000 lbs on the Interstate / 90,000 lbs on other state highways (OAC 730:50-5-4/-13/-14).
Escort matrix, superload definition, fees and legal limits confirmed from the official OAC 730:50-5 rule PDF and ODOT fee schedule (oklahoma.gov). Rule text effective 2023-09-11.
